## Target and gate model

This is a private whitelabel fork for Linux servers on Fly.io, with Fly Sprites planned for agent sandboxes. Keep the shipped Docker target at linux/amd64. Public cargo-dist/GitHub package releases and Windows lanes are out of scope; retain the Fly image build and smoke coverage. The organization lacks Enterprise Cloud, so do not depend on merge queues: gate direct PRs and require four roll-ups on protected main: Code Style (fmt + clippy), Tests (Reborn), Reborn E2E, and Platform & Compat. Reborn E2E and Platform & Compat are independent checks.

## CI scope

Run the selected deterministic E2E suite on every PR using mocks. Cover GitHub, Gmail, Google Calendar, Docs, Drive, Sheets, Slides, Slack, Exa web-access, and web-app/browser push. Omit live Telegram, Notion MCP, NearAI MCP, and Mem0 lanes. Keep native-memory contract tests temporarily until Hindsight replaces the current memory path. Non-OpenAI providers must continue compiling, but only direct OpenAI API-key calls are supported; add a weekly/manual secret-backed OpenAI smoke. Named-function cargo-mutants execution is currently merge-queue-only: move execution to nightly/manual while retaining selection/manifest validation on PRs.

Keep Codecov upload and Slack alerting optional when external configuration is absent. Always retain actual test results and LCOV/coverage artifacts; optional publication must not hide test or coverage failures.

## Inherited failures to repair

Bootstrap PR #1 was squash-merged at b543f5003f099ee625010bd0549cc6bd5125d5b9; reviewed head cb7e845 had failing gates. cargo deny reported 63 diagnostics across 60 RustSec IDs plus a Docker MUSL override diagnostic. Wasmtime 47.0.4/wasmtime-wasi 47.0.4 account for 36 diagnostics, zip 8.6.0 for eight; chrono 0.4.45 and chrono-tz 0.10.4 reported no safe upgrade. Resolve compatible findings and explicitly review any necessary exception; do not suppress the audit wholesale.

The QA replay receipt was stale by 119 days against the 45-day maximum. Run the exact manifest command, then refresh the tested commit/date only after it passes:

uv run --project tests/e2e --python 3.12 pytest tests/e2e/scenarios/test_reborn_qa_trace_replay.py::test_every_harvested_trace_replays -q

Main also had three browser failures: admin user detail refresh, workspace tree keyboard/accessibility, and settings keyboard behavior. Slack coverage was 92.99% against a 93.45% effective floor. Repair these independently while keeping coverage measurement intact.

## Local checks and behavior constraint

Normalize the local command set across CONTRIBUTING.md and .development-system.toml. Preserve the fast pre-push path and document the full deterministic suite, scripts/ci/run-hermetic-deterministic-suite.sh all, including Docker/Postgres, Emulate, Python E2E, and Chromium prerequisites. No product behavior changes are part of this task.
event_data.summary: Deliver a green direct-PR CI and local-check baseline for the private Linux/Fly OpenAI-first fork, without changing product behavior.
event_data.title: Stabilize private Linux/Fly CI baseline and required PR checks
